'''House Thul''' was the estate of the [[House of Thul|noble family]] of the same name in [[Kaamos Territory]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Thul Palace]], [[Rhu Caenus Spaceport]], and the [[House Girard (estate)|estate]] of the vassal house [[House Girard]] was located on the grounds of the estate.
